# `silk/build/watch`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Running a command again each time a project's sources change, for `silk dev`.

The command runs as the leader of its own process group, so that stopping it also stops the
program it started. While it runs, SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGHUP are held: the next look stops the
group, and `restarting` answers 128 plus the signal's number. It needs macOS or Linux.
